items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Jules Reiner, piano. Do you know anything about him? No. I don't know that name. [INTERVIEWEE] No. I know the bass player, but I can't think of his name.

ctx.x: Is it your mother of the same family, or...?
Might be. But Reiner is the piano player.
